title: Name, birth date and the family house on Villere Street
summary: Willard checks his name and birth date against published sources; he was born March 3, 1906 at 1726 Villere Street in the seventh ward, lived there all his life, and the house was sold cheaply at auction after his grandmother died.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: do you want to start back at the beginning? And I've found a couple of conflicting accounts in the John Milton book and in Leonard's Encyclopedia starting with your name.
Is it Leon Albany or Albany Leon?
Okay, which is -- that's the way John Milton has it.
And your birth date is correct, is it not? Because they both have it as March 3, 1906.
And you were born in New Orleans and Milton says on Villere Street. Is that right? V-i-l --
On Villere Street in New Orleans.
New Orleans, yes. That's known as the seventh ward.
Was there a specific address on Villere Street?

All my life. My grandfather, he bought this house and he bought another one and we all stayed there. And the house, the only time it ever changed hand is when my grandmother died. When he died nobody could touch the house until my grandmother died, and all the property was divided amongst his children, and so --
The house, is it still there in New Orleans?

No, it's gone now. It was so old and when she died they had so many children to be divided that they couldn't wait to get a decent price for it, so they had it up for auction. So they practically got nothing for it, and that's the way it went, a very cheap modest price. It was practically rotten.
